scope: Read-only source audit followed by authorized V1 UI changes. Runtime verification is still pending in the assembled V1 worktree.

sources.verified: Official live page: a concise objective, in-play remaining-move feedback, How to play, explicit retry and next actions, and local statistics continuity.
sources.applied: Keep help close to play, use truthful mistake labels, and make the next round the primary result action. This is an interaction inference, not copied branding.

sources.verified: Official hints: two-item exploration, no exploration penalty, items with no further use can be hidden, and optional progress-based hints.
sources.applied: Preserve Alchimie free exploration and already-earned journal; do not add setup or compulsory objectives. Keep rules distinct from paid/earned hints.

unavailable_sources.status: Blocked by retrieval; no visual or interaction inspection claimed.
Retrieval returned only JavaScript-required placeholder; no interface inspection claimed.

implemented_findings.problem: Daily circuit links opened normal game setup, whose primary action started free play. Free results do not advance the daily circuit.
implemented_findings.change: Carry challenge=daily through route; promote explicit daily start in shared intro, retain free alternative and existing saved-game resume. No automatic POST.

implemented_findings.problem: remaining_mistakes shown as attempts, although successful guesses do not consume this budget.
implemented_findings.change: Label GREȘELI with unchanged server count.

implemented_findings.problem: Rules required opening options then opening rules. For quick games options contained nothing else.
implemented_findings.change: Expose one direct rules disclosure below play; keep additional options separate and only present when needed. Exploration already has direct help.

implemented_findings.problem: Copy result was primary/first; quick-game change-options only returned to an identical intro with no adjustable options.
implemented_findings.change: Replay first and primary, copy secondary, remove empty quick-game options action. Do not auto-replay.

implemented_findings.problem: Six progress controls preceded the six actual descriptive game cards on a fresh visit.
implemented_findings.change: Game cards precede daily circuit and records.

implemented_findings.problem: Shared daily tooltip referred to chosen difficulty even in quick games that have none.
implemented_findings.change: Use mode-appropriate descriptions without claiming nonexistent controls.

six_game_map.alchimie: Default exploration remains penalty-free, tap-tap crafting and optional goals. Challenge setup has easy default and collapsed customization. Challenge rules flattened; exploration direct help kept. Collection recovery, ownership and bounds untouched.
six_game_map.intrusul: Easy starter preserved; direct one-tap answer and unlocked hint preserved. Direct rules, truthful mistakes, no empty result options; replay first. Daily circuit intent fixed.
six_game_map.perechi: Tap first/re-tap cancel/tap second submit, board focus and paid hint unchanged. Same rules/mistake/result/daily improvements as Intrusul.
six_game_map.conexiuni: Easy default, four-selection verification, one-away guidance, clear selection/shuffle and staged clue logic preserved. Direct rules, replay first, daily circuit intent fixed.
six_game_map.contexto: Easy default, rank explanation, unknown-word recovery, progressive clues and reveal confirmation preserved. Direct rules, replay first, daily circuit intent fixed.
six_game_map.lant: Easy default, visible legal choices, typed alternative, undo, persistent earned captions/hints preserved. Direct rules, replay first, daily circuit intent fixed.

verification_design.new_browser_tests: frontend/e2e/v1-testing-ux.spec.mjs: 11 tests per desktop/mobile project; six daily starts, lobby order, saved-game protection, two quick replays, successful pair preserving mistakes.
verification_design.adapted_browser_tests: Existing rules, keyboard focus, hint recovery, queued score/resume and quick-phone layout tests adapted without deleting ownership, network or persistence assertions.
verification_design.unverified: Physical-device testing and human fun/accessibility acceptance are not implied by source audit.
